homonyms.basis: The census row carries no disambiguation field. No card is a homonym: all seven concern the workstream (five PAI's pages, Sama's post on the white paper, OECD.AI's catalogue entry for the library; the video is PAI's). The distinct entities below are named by the field or the census beside the workstream and are not senses of its name.
distinct_entities: Partnership on AI (the operator; Wikipedia's article, B10)
DeepMind / Google DeepMind (the partner developer, a PAI Partner and founding member; T names it 'Google DeepMind')
Sama (Samasource Impact Sourcing, Inc.; a data annotation vendor, author of card 5)
Guidelines for AI and Shared Prosperity (PAI, 2023; a distinct PAI work that includes responsible-sourcing recommendations)
BSR's initiative on labor rights in the AI data supply chain (a distinct initiative PAI supports)
the OECD.AI Catalogue of Tools & Metrics for Trustworthy AI (the catalogue carrying card 6)

the AI Incident Database (another work of the operator, announced by PAI in November 2020, now the Responsible AI Collaborative's; the neighbouring /non row datasets/negative-of-the-negative/v2/rows/ai-incident-database.json)

captures.description: PARTNERSHIP ON AI RESPONSIBLE SOURCING, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'The Partnership on AI (PAI) focuses on responsible sourcing through its workstream on Responsible Sourcing Across the Data Supply Line, which aims to improve working conditions, fair pay, and well-being for global data enrichment and annotation professionals.' Four resources (the white paper, vendor engagement guidance, the transparency template, the guidelines and checklists) and the DeepMind collaboration. Seven cards, five of them PAI's own.
